summary: Backend testing for NEW Virtual Artist Studio feature (/api/studio/* + /api/posts/*) plus light regression sweep. 35/35 pytest tests passed against the deployed preview URL. Includes real Claude Sonnet 4.6 call via EMERGENT_LLM_KEY which succeeded and returned a valid config JSON with theme in the allowed set.

minor.issue: Returns 404 with detail 'Not found' when the caller is authenticated but not the post owner (nor admin) — semantically should be 403. Same 404-instead-of-403 pattern flagged for commissions in iteration_3. Cosmetic authz-vs-notfound conflation.

Every anonymous GET increments config.visits by 1 with no dedupe/throttle (bots, refresh spam, or the artist themselves viewing their own studio inflate the metric). Consider IP/user session dedupe or excluding self-views.

On LlmChat failure the endpoint returns 500 with raw exception text truncated to 200 chars — acceptable but leaks internal error strings to callers. Also no rate limiting: an artist could spam Claude calls (cost concern).

Idempotent (returns {liked: true, already: true} on duplicate) — good. However DELETE /api/posts/{id}/like on a post that was never liked returns 200 with liked:false and does NOT decrement (safe), but there's no 404 for non-existent post_id in like/unlike/pin — silent no-op could hide client bugs.

action_items: OPTIONAL: Change PATCH /api/posts/{id}/pin non-owner branch to raise 403 instead of 404 (matches expected authz semantics).
OPTIONAL: Dedupe /api/studio/{artist_id} visit increments (skip when GET is by the artist themselves or throttle per-IP/session).
OPTIONAL: Sanitize AI designer 500 error message; add per-user rate limit on /api/studio/ai-design to control Claude spend.
OPTIONAL: Return 404 if post_id doesn't exist on like/unlike/pin endpoints.
critical_code_review_comments: studio.get_studio: uses find + sort on artworks/auctions/posts every call with no pagination or projection — for artists with 500+ works this loads full docs into memory. Consider lean projections or limit=50 default.
studio.default_config stores views_by_artwork as an empty dict — never populated anywhere in studio.py. Either wire it into an artwork-view endpoint or remove the field.

studio.ai_design: json.loads without a schema validator; only theme is coerced. If Claude returns a lighting.intensity string or missing keys, response leaks into frontend as-is. Add Pydantic model to validate cfg shape before returning.
studio.ai_design: on markdown code fence handling, `text.split('```', 2)[1]` will IndexError on malformed responses — caught by outer try/except but produces generic 500. Consider defensive parsing.
posts_router.list_posts: no auth on GET is fine (public), but no cap on limit query param — client can pass limit=100000 and DoS the DB. Clamp to e.g. min(limit, 100).
post_likes have no unique compound index on (post_id, user_id) — race condition allows double-inserts if two requests land simultaneously, inflating like_count. Add unique index.
unlike_post decrements like_count via $inc: -1 without a $max guard — a race with concurrent unlike could push count negative. Consider a Mongo update guard `like_count > 0` or floor at 0 on read.

studio.py imports `require_role` from auth but relies on it in multiple endpoints without any tests for admin-vs-artist behavior differences (both are allowed). The admin PATCH mutates admin's own studio config — is that intentional? Confirm product intent.
No DELETE /api/studio endpoint to reset config to defaults — artists cannot undo AI designer changes without manually resetting each field.

studio_configs and studio_posts collections have no indexes declared anywhere I could see (no init_db entries for them) — queries on artist_id will do collection scans. Add indexes on studio_configs.artist_id (unique) and studio_posts.artist_id + created_at.
